stable.release_notes: AgentNEO 3.0.29 isolates ComfyUI CUDA/cuDNN from AgentNEO speech CUDA paths, adds one-click FIX CUDA/cuDNN recovery with a real GPU convolution self-test, and preserves v3.0.28 model-tuning controls. The formal selective-updater baseline is 3.0.28; direct compatibility from 3.0.26 and 3.0.27 was additionally verified against the exact published 3.0.29 updater.
